summary: The player weaves right and left across the lane, firing three level-3 charged arcs: the first disarms a small ship near the top-left, the second misses a cluster of ships on the left, and the third hits a ship near the player just as the player takes a bullet hit and loses a life.

events.evidence: A wide cyan arc (charged shot) sweeps up and hits a pink-outlined ship at top-left; white ring expands, score jumps from 200 to 300, a metallic clatter sound plays, and the ship remains intact without its pink outline.
Player ship moves sharply from center-bottom to the far right edge.
Player reverses from the right edge back toward the center.
The 3-bar cyan CANNON gauge empties, a wide cyan arc launches from the player ship, and a whoosh-pop release sound plays.
The cyan arc travels up the center-right of the lane while the three pink-outlined ships drift on the left; the arc passes without hitting anything.
Player drifts right toward the lower-right side of the lane.
Player moves back left toward the bottom-center.
The 3-bar cyan CANNON gauge empties and a wide cyan arc launches directly into an approaching pink-outlined ship.
The arc strikes the ship right in front of the player; score jumps from 300 to 500, a metallic breakup sound plays, and the ship's hull continues upward without its pink outline.
A pink enemy bullet reaches the player at bottom-center; the screen edges flash red, a heavy low crunch/thud plays, and the top-right pink pips drop from 3 to 2.

readability_issues.issue: Disarmed enemy hulls turn dark grey and blend heavily into the dark grey lane floor, making it hard to see where the surviving hulls are drifting.

The bright white glow of the fully charged player ship overlaps the incoming pink enemy bullet at point-blank range, making the bullet that causes the life loss at 5.5s hard to track right before impact.
